text: I need to clarify a few details: Was there any history of chorioamnionitis or maternal fever during labor, and what specific type of seizures is the infant experiencing? REQUEST TEST: Serum electrolytes, glucose, calcium, magnesium, and ammonia levels.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the metabolic panel is normal, we must look elsewhere for the cause. Has the infant been exposed to any medications in utero, and do you have a record of the umbilical cord blood gas analysis from birth? REQUEST IMAGES: Cranial_Ultrasound.

speaker: Patient
text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. The antenatal period was complicated by chorioamnionitis. Apgar scores were 3 and 6 at 1 and 5 minutes, respectively. The patient has become increasingly lethargic over the past 18 hours and experienced a tonic seizure lasting for 25 seconds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE) secondary to perinatal asphyxia.
